messages:
lina_support: Hey team — customer acme-inc reporting intermittent 5xxs + huge p99 latency since yesterday. They say requests are being served out of eu even though their org is pinned to us-west. attaching logs/snippets.

sam_engineer: can you paste a failing request id and headers so we can repro quickly?

lina_support: req ids: req_20260317_01, req_20260317_07. Their client sends header `x-client-region: us-west-2` and Authorization token looks valid. repro curl:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" -H \"x-client-region: us-west-2\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
Response often times out or returns 502 from eu nodes. They also noted occasional auth errors (401) even though token is the same.

kevin_sre: hmm. We pushed a config change to failover policies last night. Quick peek at the policy for that account shows what might be the issue:
```
{"failover": [{"region":"eu-west-1","priority":1,"weight":100}, {"region":"us-west-2","priority":2,"weight":0}]}
```
That looks inverted — eu has higher priority and us-west has zero weight. If sticky routing is on, sessions may be hashing into eu by default.

sam_engineer: good catch. Also noticed stickyRouting set to `true` but `sessionKey` is empty in that policy. Without a session key the router falls back to consistent-hash on client id which for their traffic maps to eu.

jia_prod: tagging @oncall and starting rollback for that customer's policy to the last known-good. :arrow_down:

deploy-bot: Initiating config rollback (cfg-rollback-918) for org acme-inc by jia_prod. ETA ~2m.

kevin_sre: immediate mitigation applied: forced region override for org -> us-west-2 and disabled stickyRouting for that org until we validate sessionKey behavior.

lina_support: pushed workaround to customer and asked them to retry — they just confirmed requests are now consistently hitting us-west and p95 dropped to ~120ms.  :white_check_mark:

sam_engineer: action items: (1) add validation on policy edits to prevent inverted priorities / zero-weight primary, (2) require sessionKey whenever stickyRouting=true, (3) add post-change smoke check that probes preferred region.

kevin_sre: filing INF-344 for the validation + audit trail for policy changes. Also will add alert that detects sudden cross-region traffic for orgs pinned to a single region.

lina_support: thanks everyone. Closing on this thread for now — will reopen if customer sees regressions. :thumbsup:\n
